description: Defines the ShippingQuoteRequestLog entity for persisting quote request logs in the database. Includes fields for request details such as request ID, customer ID, destination, currency, weight, timestamps, and JSON payloads.

classes.name: ShippingQuoteRequestLog
classes.description: Entity class for logging shipping quote requests, including details like request ID, customer info, destination, weight, timestamps, and JSON payloads.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Automatically sets the creation timestamp if not already set before persisting the entity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the primary key ID of the log record.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the UUID associated with the quote request.

methods.name: setRequestId
methods.description: Sets the UUID for the quote request.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Returns the customer ID associated with the quote request.

methods.name: getDestinationCountry
methods.description: Returns the destination country for the shipping request.

methods.name: getDestinationPostalCode
methods.description: Returns the postal code of the destination.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency used for the quote.

methods.name: getTotalWeightGrams
methods.description: Returns the total weight of the shipment in grams.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of when the log was created.

methods.name: getRequestJson
methods.description: Returns the JSON string of the request payload.

methods.name: getResponseJson
methods.description: Returns the JSON string of the response payload.
